# Rock: a jittered icosahedron, flattened, flat shaded. Up Z, resting on z 0.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.32 --location 0 0 0.12
scale 1 0.8 0.65
apply
material new Stone --base-color 0.663 0.663 0.580
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.06 --seed 7
mode object
shade flat
export rock.glb
